attr.title: GreenOvercast
attr.desc: An unofficial native Xbox Cloud Gaming client with a searchable, controller-first library for Linux handhelds.
attr.inst: Requires an Xbox Game Pass plan that includes cloud gaming and internet access. First launch uses Microsoft's device-code sign-in.
